Title: Data Scientist / Sr Data Scientist
Description: About Aplazo Aplazo is Mexico's leading BNPL platform, built for a market where 40% of users have no credit history and traditional credit checks simply don't work. We operate at the intersection of financial inclusion and technology, enabling millions of Mexicans to make fractionated payments online and in-store without a credit card. We've cracked alternative data lending at scale, achieving the lowest default rates in LATAM while growing rapidly. With $110 million raised across Series A+ and Series B, we are well-capitalised and growing across every vertical. Data Science at Aplazo is deeply embedded in how the business runs, not a separate function that hands off work downstream. The team works closely with Credit, Fraud, Collections, Growth and Product to build and own models that run in production and directly shape business decisions. The Role Most data science roles ask you to go deep in one domain. This one asks you to go wide, and still be excellent. As a Senior Data Scientist, you'll work across Credit Risk, Growth, and AI initiatives based on where the team needs the most leverage at any given time. Some quarters that means contributing to a fraud model. Others it means owning a personalization or growth experiment end-to-end. You'll be expected to ramp quickly, work with high autonomy, and deliver without needing a fully paved path. This role is critical to how we scale, it creates the flexibility and redundancy the team needs to execute across a wide roadmap without breaking. What You'll Own Contribute across Credit Risk (underwriting, fraud, collections), Growth (personalization, recommendations, incentivization), and AI initiatives based on team priorities Own projects end-to-end within your assigned domain, data, modeling, deployment, and post-launch monitoring Develop deep familiarity across multiple domains and systems, enabling the team to move faster and maintain continuity as we scale Drive research and exploration workstreams, evaluating new modeling approaches, alternative data sources, and tooling that keeps Aplazo ahead of the curve Collaborate closely with Lead and Staff Data Scientists to deliver on the broader roadmap Identify and flag opportunities for improvement across domains, you'll often be the person with the broadest view of what's working and what isn't What We're Looking For Must-haves 4–8 years of experience across more than one data science domain, Risk, Growth, Personalization, or similar Strong ML fundamentals, you can pick the right tool for the problem rather than defaulting to what you know best Demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on unfamiliar problems and deliver with limited guidance Proficiency in Python, SQL, and standard ML frameworks Hands-on experience with LLMs / GenAI as part of your regular workflow Production experience, you've taken models past the notebook stage Strong Plus Fintech or BNPL background, familiarity with credit risk or fraud modeling concepts Experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing at scale Exposure to MLOps practices, feature pipelines, model monitoring, deployment Publications or presentations in recognized Machine Learning and Data Science journals / conferences AI-First, Not AI-Curious Aplazo operates as an AI-first company, AI is embedded in how we build, not bolted on. We're looking for someone who has genuinely changed how they work because of AI, using it to move faster, explore more, and reduce time spent on low-value tasks. Breadth is a strength in this role, and AI tooling is a big part of how you maintain quality across multiple domains. What This Is Not The best person for this role is someone who brings genuine curiosity across domains and takes ownership without needing a fully defined problem. You'll work with a high degree of autonomy, and the breadth of your contribution will matter as much as the depth. Why This Role Rare opportunity to build breadth across Risk, Growth, and AI at a company where all three domains actually matter Small, senior team, you'll work alongside and learn from some of the strongest DS practitioners in fintech Direct impact on business outcomes, no layers, no hand-offs Strong foundation for a future specialist or lead role as the team scales Personal data collected during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the Privacy Notice of Aplaz, S.A. de C.V. Shopify Admin REST and GraphQL APIs, Storefront API, Shopify CLI, and Shopify Flow. Strong debugging, problem-solving, and performance-tuning skills across both server-side and client-side code. Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment and supporting remote teams; able to meet deadlines consistently and manage multiple concurrent work streams. Title: Data Science Intern
Description: Are you a bright, analytical mind eager to dive deep into data and uncover insights that drive strategic decisions? Do you have a passion for data science and want to apply your skills in a real-world consulting environment? We are looking for a curious and driven Data Science Intern to join our dynamic team. This is an exceptional opportunity for you to apply your data science knowledge to retrieve, organize, analyze, and visualize data, directly supporting our consulting work. You will play a key role in testing hypotheses, uncovering relationships (correlations, drivers, patterns), and feeding forecasting models, making a tangible impact on our projects. If you enjoy analysis, experimentation, and communicating findings, this internship is designed for you to grow your skills and contribute to meaningful work. What You'll Do & Learn (Key Responsibilities & Learning Opportunities): Data Wrangling & Retrieval: Master the art of extracting and preparing data from various sources (files, databases, APIs, internal systems). You'll learn to clean, transform, and structure complex datasets for robust analysis. Exploratory Data Analysis: Conduct in-depth exploratory analysis to identify patterns, correlations, seasonality, and anomalies. You'll develop your ability to summarize and present your findings clearly and concisely. Hypothesis Testing & Experimentation: Propose and execute rigorous statistical tests, applying sound statistical reasoning to prove or reject hypotheses. You'll gain hands-on experience with statistical testing (t-test/ANOVA) and classification models, learning to interpret results and articulate limitations. Dashboarding & Storytelling: Create impactful dashboards and compelling visualizations to communicate complex data insights to teammates and stakeholders, honing your data storytelling abilities. Collaborative Impact: Work closely with experienced professionals, contributing your analytical skills to solve real business challenges and influence strategic recommendations. What We're Looking For (Requirements): Technical Proficiency: Solid command of Python for data analysis (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn). Experience with a dashboarding tool such as Power BI or Tableau (or an equivalent). Statistical Foundation: Strong fundamentals in statistics and experimental thinking, including: Understanding of hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and p-values. Familiarity with statistical testing (t-test/ANOVA) and classification models. Ability to interpret results critically and identify limitations or assumptions. Language Skills: Fluent English (written and spoken) for daily collaboration within our international team. Team-Ready Habits: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly. Proactive in asking insightful questions and seeking clarification. Diligence in documenting your work for clarity and reproducibility. Education: Currently enrolled student from 4th semester onward in: Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Who Should Apply: This role is ideal for students who are passionate about data, enjoy analytical challenges, thrive on experimentation, and are eager to communicate their findings to a broader audience. If you're looking for an internship where you can make a real impact and grow your data science career, we encourage you to apply! Why Join Our Team? Real-World Impact: Contribute to consulting projects that shape business strategies. Mentorship & Growth: Learn from experienced data scientists and consultants in a supportive environment. Skill Development: Enhance your technical, analytical, and communication skills with practical application. Collaborative Culture: Be part of a team that values curiosity, innovation, and teamwork. Future Opportunities: Build a strong foundation for a career in data science or consulting. How to Apply: To apply for this exciting opportunity, please submit the following: Your CV (1 page preferred) A short note (5-8 lines) detailing: Your current semester and major. Your motivation for this internship and what you hope to achieve. Siemens is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.
